army_rules.name: Acts of Faith
army_rules.rules_text: If your Army Faction is Adepta Sororitas, each unit from your army with this ability can perform one Act of Faith per phase by using one Miracle Dice from your Miracle pool. A Miracle Dice can substitute one dice rolled for a Hit roll, Wound roll, Saving throw, Damage roll, Advance roll, Charge roll or Battle-shock test. The substituted result counts as an unmodified roll of that value.

rule.name: The Blood of Martyrs
rule.rules_text: Each time an ADEPTA SORORITAS model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that model's unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that model's unit is Below Half-strength.

enhancements.name: Saintly Example
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. When the bearer is destroyed, you gain an additional D3 Miracle dice.

enhancements.name: Through Suffering, Strength
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons. If the bearer has lost one or more wounds, add 2 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: Chaplet of Sacrifice
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. At the end of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll 1 Miracle dice from your Miracle dice pool and return it to your Miracle dice pool showing the new result you rolled. When doing so, if the bearer's unit is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll up to 3 Miracle dice in this way instead.

enhancements.name: Mantle of Ophelia
enhancements.rules_text: CANONESS or PALATINE model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1.

stratagems.name: Divine Intervention
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: You can discard 1-3 Miracle dice. At the end of the phase, set up one destroyed CHARACTER model from your unit on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a Starting Strength of 1. Roll one D3, adding 1 to the result for each Miracle dice you discarded. That model has that number of wounds remaining (up to its starting number of wounds).
restrictions: You cannot select SAINT CELESTINE as the target of this Stratagem.
You cannot select the same CHARACTER as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: Suffering and Sacrifice
stratagems.timing: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY or ADEPTA SORORITAS WALKER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects its targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.

stratagems.name: Righteous Vengeance
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and, if your unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.name: Sanctified Immolation
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS VEHICLE model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model's Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.

stratagems.name: Spirit of the Martyr
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Praise the Fallen
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

rule.name: Desperate for Redemption
rule.rules_text:
At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the following Vows of Atonement to be active for your army until the start of the next battle round. You can only select each Vow of Atonement once per battle.

The Path of the Penitent
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of PENITENT models from your army.

Absolution in Battle
Each time a unit from your army is selected to fight, if that unit made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by PENITENT models in that unit.

Death Before Disgrace
Each time a PENITENT model from your army is destroyed by a melee attack, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 2+, do not remove it from play, the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

enhancements.name: Psalm of Righteous Judgement
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time an enemy unit is destroyed by a PENITENT unit from your army, you can discard 1 Miracle dice then gain 1 Miracle dice showing a value of 6.

enhancements.name: Verse of Holy Piety
enhancements.rules_text: PENITENT model only. Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, select one Vow of Atonement. Until the start of the next battle round, that Vow of Atonement is active for the bearer's unit in addition to any that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that Vow of Atonement this battle.

enhancements.name: Refrain of Enduring Faith
enhancements.rules_text: PENITENT model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Catechism of Divine Penitence
enhancements.rules_text: CANONESS, PALATINE or MINISTORUM PRIEST model only. The bearer gains the PENITENT keyword.
restrictions: CANONESS, PALATINE or MINISTORUM PRIEST model only.

stratagems.name: Final Redemption
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One PENITENT unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of an objective marker you controlled. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

stratagems.name: Purity of Suffering
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One PENITENT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, PENITENT models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

stratagems.name: Passion of the Penitent
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One PENITENT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a PENITENT model in your unit makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Lash of Guilt
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just before a PENITENT unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That PENITENT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the PENITENT ENGINES keyword, do not make an Advance roll for it; instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Boundless Zeal
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit has the PENITENT keyword, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.

stratagems.name: Devout Fanaticism
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One PENITENT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

rule.name: Sacred Rites
rule.rules_text: Each ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army can perform up to two Acts of Faith per phase, instead of just one.

enhancements.name: Litanies of Faith
enhancements.rules_text: CANONESS or PALATINE model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, take a Leadership test for the bearer. If that test is passed, you gain 1 Miracle dice.

enhancements.name: Blade of Saint Ellynor
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 1, and those weapons have the [PRECISION] ability. In addition, each time the bearer fights, if one or more enemy models are destroyed by those attacks, you gain 1 Miracle dice.

enhancements.name: Divine Aspect
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer; that unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that test is failed, you gain 1 Miracle dice.

enhancements.name: Triptych of the Macharian Crusade
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. Each time the bearer uses an Act of Faith to substitute a saving throw, that saving throw is successful, irrespective of the value of the Miracle dice used.

stratagems.name: Shield of Faith
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit, or one friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit within 3" of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds. If you targeted an ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit from your army with this Stratagem, then until the end of the phase, while a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 3" of your unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Light of the Emperor
stratagems.timing: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is blessed. While a unit is blessed, it can ignore any or all modifiers to the following profile characteristics of its models, the Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models, any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws). If your unit has the JUMP PACK keyword, until the end of the turn, while a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 3" of your unit, that friendly unit is also blessed.

stratagems.name: Faith and Fury
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of your unit's attacks this phase, you gain 1 Miracle dice.

stratagems.name: Blinding Radiance
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, or one friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit within 3" of such a unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If you targeted an ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit from your army with this Stratagem, then until the end of the phase, while a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY unit is within 3" of your unit, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Divine Guidance
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of those attacks, you gain 1 Miracle dice.

stratagems.name: Angelic Descent
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
restrictions: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

detachments.name: Champions of Faith

rule.name: Righteous Purpose
rule.rules_text:
In your Command phase, you can select up to 3 ADEPTA SORORITAS units from your army (including units that are embarked within TRANSPORTS), until the start of your next Command phase, those units are Righteous. While a unit is Righteous:

• Add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.
• Improve the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.
• Improve the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by BATTLE SISTERS SQUAD, CELESTIAN SACRESANTS and PARAGON WARSUITS models in that unit by 1.

keywords: While a CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit from your army is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of Celestian Sacresants models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Triptych of Judgement
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristics and/or any modifiers to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Mark of Devotion
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons. While the bearer's unit is Righteous, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic and add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: Eyes of the Oracle
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. The bearer's weapons have the [PRECISION] ability. Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy CHARACTER model, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Sanctified Amulet
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. Enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer.

stratagems.name: Shield of Denial
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability against mortal wounds. If your unit is Righteous until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds instead.

stratagems.name: Suffer Not the Unfaithful
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that is Righteous and that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

stratagems.name: To the Heart of Heresy
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. If your unit is Righteous until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Path of the Righteous
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, if your unit is Righteous, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Bastion of Faith
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. In addition, if your unit is Righteous, you can select one other CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit from your army that is not Battle-shocked and is within 6" of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets that CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll as well.

stratagems.name: Indefatigable Dedication
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is Righteous, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.

rule.name: Angelic Judgement
rule.rules_text:
Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY FLY units have the following ability:

Condemnatory Psalms: In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one visible enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is condemned:

• While a unit is condemned, that unit has +3" detection range.

enhancements.name: Clarion of Urgency
enhancements.rules_text: CANONESS WITH JUMP PACK model only. At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can place this unit in Strategic Reserves.
restrictions: CANONESS WITH JUMP PACK model only.

enhancements.name: Symphonic Payload
enhancements.rules_text: EXORCIST unit only. This unit can re-roll rolls to determine the A of a weapon.

stratagems.name: Inspirational Battle Canticles
stratagems.timing: Start of the Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY FLY unit or one friendly EXORCIST unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Battle-shocked ADEPTA SORORITAS unit within 6" of your unit. That unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Harmonised Exorcism
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EXORCIST unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That EXORCIST unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one unit visible to and within 9" of a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY FLY unit. Your unit's ranged attacks that target that unit have +1 to Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Devastating Reprise
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EXORCIST unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY FLY unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) hit by those ranged attacks. Your unit's ranged attacks that target that unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

rule.name: Holy Quest
rule.rules_text:
Friendly CELESTIAN SACRESANTS units' attacks have +1 BS and WS.

This detachment has the REVEREND tag and cannot be taken with another REVEREND detachment.

enhancements.name: Writ of Communion
enhancements.rules_text: CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit only. This unit has +1 OC.

enhancements.name: Perfervid Haste
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTA SORORITAS model only. This unit has +1" M.

stratagems.name: Sanctified Blows
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have +1 A and S.

stratagems.name: Faithful Fortitude
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Unflinching Determination
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn. That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

rule.name: Hymns of Battle
rule.rules_text:
• Enhancements selected from this detachment do not count towards the total number of enhancements in your army.
• Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER units have +1 Ld.

enhancements.name: Hagiomnifex
enhancements.rules_text:
ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER model only (excluding PENITENT units). Once per turn, per unit. At the start of a phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one of the abilities below:

• Rite of Revelation: While this unit is shooting, enemy units have +6" detection range.
• Sermon of Intolerance: This unit's Battle-shock rolls automatically succeed.
• Catechism of Raging Fervour: This unit has +1 M.
• Psalm of Righteous Smiting: This unit's attacks have +1 S.
• Chorus of Repudiation: Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit's T have -1 to Wound rolls.
restrictions: ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER model only (excluding PENITENT units).

abilities.name: Auto-Tapestry of the Emperor’s Judgement
abilities.rules_text: While this unit is leading a unit and contains an Aestred Thurga model, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

abilities.name: Recount the Deeds of the Saints
abilities.rules_text: While this unit is leading a unit and contains an Agathae Dolan model, each time that unit destroys an enemy unit, you gain 1 Miracle dice. When that Agathae Dolan model is destroyed, you gain D3 Miracle dice.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Battle Sisters Squad; Celestian Insidiants; Celestian Sacresants; Dominion Squad; Retributor Squad; Sisters Novitiate Squad.

units.name: Canoness

abilities.name: Sacred Command
abilities.rules_text: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

abilities.name: The Emperor's Grace
abilities.rules_text: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, this model has a 2+ invulnerable save.

wargear_abilities.name: Null Rod
wargear_abilities.rules_text: Models in the bearer's unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds and Psychic Attacks.

wargear_abilities.name: Rod of Office
wargear_abilities.rules_text: Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Battle Sisters Squad; Celestian Insidiants; Celestian Sacresants; Dominion Squad; Retributor Squad; Sisters Novitiate Squad.

wargear_options: This model's bolt pistol can be replaced with one of the following: 1 condemnor boltgun; 1 inferno pistol; 1 plasma pistol.
This model's hallowed chainsword can be replaced with one of the following: 1 blessed blade; 1 power weapon.
If this model is equipped with a hallowed chainsword, it can be equipped with one of the following: 1 brazier of holy fire; 1 null rod.
If this model is equipped with a plasma pistol and a power weapon, it can be equipped with: 1 rod of office.

units.name: Canoness with Jump Pack

abilities.name: Sacred Command
abilities.rules_text: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

abilities.name: Divine Deliverance
abilities.rules_text: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model and those weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Seraphim Squad; Zephyrim Squad.

wargear_options: This model's blessed halberd can be replaced with one of the following: 1 holy eviscerator; 1 Ministorum hand flamer and 1 power weapon.

abilities.name: Core
abilities.rules_text: Deep Strike, Fights First, Lone Operative

abilities.name: Holy Judgement
abilities.rules_text: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to this unit's Ephrael Stern model. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 2 from the result if it is a CHAOS unit. If the test is failed, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Mysterious Saviours
abilities.rules_text: You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that Stratagem this phase. If you do, that use is -1CP and does not prevent any uses of that Stratagem on other units this phase.

abilities.name: Laud Hailer
abilities.rules_text: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit that is Battle-shocked and within 12" of this model. That unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

abilities.name: Stirring Rhetoric
abilities.rules_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time this model's unit performs an Act of Faith, the value of one of the Miracle dice used in that Act of Faith is first changed to a 6.

support.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Battle Sisters Squad; Celestian Insidiants; Celestian Sacresants; Dominion Squad; Retributor Squad; Sisters Novitiate Squad. This model can be attached to a Battle Sisters Squad, even if one Canoness, Palatine, Junith Eruita or Aestred Thurga model has already been attached to it. If you do, and that Bodyguard unit is destroyed, the Leader units attached to it become separate units, with their original Starting Strengths.

abilities.name: Righteous Denunciation
abilities.rules_text: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within 6" of this model must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

abilities.name: Judged for Execution
abilities.rules_text: At the end of your Movement phase, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

abilities.name: The Pulpit of Saint Holline's Basilica
abilities.rules_text: This unit has Stealth. Melee attacks that target this unit have -1 to Hit rolls.

abilities.name: Fiery Conviction
abilities.rules_text: If this model is on the battlefield at the start of your Command phase, you can choose one of the following: discard 1 Miracle dice and gain 1CP; take a Leadership test for this model, if that test is passed gain 1CP.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Battle Sisters Squad; Celestian Insidiants; Celestian Sacresants; Dominion Squad; Retributor Squad; Sisters Novitiate Squad.

abilities.name: Abbess Sanctorum
